task:
Shotcut is already open with /home/user/Documents/combo.mlt (1920x1080 30 fps, empty timeline). Two source videos exist: /home/user/Videos/intro.mp4 and /home/user/Videos/outro.mp4.

Import both clips and place them on the V1 timeline track so outro.mp4 overlaps the end of intro.mp4 by approximately half a second (this creates a luma dissolve transition). Add a Fade In Video filter to the intro.mp4 clip with default parameters. Save the project.

verification.description: A fade filter is present (Fade In Video)

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CLI: project open combo.mlt, media probe intro.mp4, timeline add-clip intro.mp4 --track 1 --in 00:00:00.000, timeline add-clip outro.mp4 --track 1 --at [overlap_time], transition add luma --track-a 0 --track-b 1, filter add fadein-video --track 1 --clip 0, project save
cli_feasibility.reason: ⚠️ Complex but feasible. Requires: 1) media probe to get clip duration, 2) calculate overlap timecode, 3) place clips with overlap, 4) add transition, 5) add filter. CLI-Anything supports all operations but requires manual timing calculation. Task mentions GUI concepts but CLI can achieve same result.
